assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only silent-witch:cyril-ashley@light-novel#v1-character-monograph (the canonical V1 character monograph, version 1.1) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese light novels V01-V12 with the companions IV -after- (AFTER04) and IX -extra- (EXTRA09) and the two -another- prequel volumes, as closed at snapshot 60b21a7 (sixteen units). Cyril Ashley has viewpoint scenes in every numbered unit and companion except V03; the prequels bear on him only retrospectively and paratext is cited only as paratext. The monograph was written by a fresh-context analyst and checked mechanically and for knowledge boundaries by the integrator; neither reread the Japanese source, and owner semantic acceptance is not claimed. The master ledger, the readings, the relationship arguments and the project's own reconstruction-readiness assessment are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them; the readiness entries are known here only as the monograph reports them. No web serial, adaptation, translation or Codex G2 material is used, and the evaluator inspected no primary source. The declared scope excludes Cyril Ashley's feelings toward Monica Everett and his private reasoning about her identity before V09.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Evidence runs from Cyril Ashley's childhood with his birth father (named Wayne at V10) and his mother, Myra Wayne, through his adoption into the Highorn house at thirteen, to the end of V12. His family history is his knowledge at every story state, though the reader learns it out of order (delirium in V01, Myra's account in V04, the song in EXTRA09, Wayne at V10, the forbidden games at V11). He never learns that Thornley erased his memory or that his monthly checks stopped the embezzlement. Assessed states follow the monograph's state table (section 2.10): V01 split at his recognition of Monica Everett by office (V01 obs. 114); V02-V03 concealed protector; V04 and AFTER04; V05 split at the reconciliation with his mother (V05 obs. 155); V06-V07; V08 split at the re-founding of his loyalty on his own choice (V08 obs. 229); V09 split at the reveal and kneel (V09 obs. 008) and at the forest choice to break correctness (V09 obs. 066-067); EXTRA09-V11 after graduation; and V12, with the marriage talk declined and his heart unread (V12 obs. 166-167). Before V08 he knows Isaac Walker only as the prince Felix, and before V09 he has no stated verdict on Monica Everett's identity. No state after V12 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives a discriminating account of Cyril Ashley: care given under the cover of duty, with a small fixed vocabulary of true but incomplete pretexts (section 5); recognition welcome when addressed to his work and wounding when addressed to his blood or his birth father's teaching (V04 obs. 014, V10 obs. 037); self-blame broad and self-credit narrow (V02 obs. 098, V07 obs. 166, V12 obs. 207); and a loyalty whose foundation changes by state, from an assigned object to his own choice (V08 obs. 229) and from procedure to judgment (V09 obs. 067). It predicts his mistakes: taking blame he did not cause, misreading a ticket as a duty, confiding upward but not to juniors, and holding formality against Isaac Walker's invitation. A would overclaim: his self-report almost never names a motive, his interior is spare on desire, the duty reading keeps real support, and the monograph reports the project ledger's INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE readiness entries at every Cyril checkpoint. C would understate an account that says what changes his response and where it stops.

The monograph orders Cyril Ashley's states from V01 to V12 with the mechanism for each (section 2.10), keeps source, revelation and diegetic order and participant knowledge apart, and sets his family history out in both orders (section 4). It records what does not change: he shouts at V09 as at V01, keeps 'Highness' for Isaac Walker at V10, calls his constitution a burden at V07 and blames himself at V12. A is rejected: he has no viewpoint in V03, elapsed time is sparse, and the version 1.1 amendment re-kinds two late state records (SW-S-0216, SW-S-0228) as a relationship change and an unresolved feeling rather than development.

The monograph records written speech for Cyril Ashley: a formal first-person pronoun in a stiff, archaic masculine register; hyperbolic oaths for the prince; a shouting default toward juniors and a gentle register in bounded situations (the careful dance, the sickroom, the song, the ball); a curt one-word assent (V03 obs. 063, V10 obs. 107); the aversion to 'cannot' and its later opening into the language of help; and an address ledger by recipient and state (section 10). His address is distinctive enough that Monica Everett unmasks an impostor by it (V04 section 6.12). B would overclaim: no Japanese is quoted and the pronoun itself is not named, so no first-person form, sentence ending or lexicon is given, and there is no voice evidence. D would understate stable register conditions and a located address ledger.

Section 9 locates ordinary conduct with its driver: the hidden care is most visible in ordinary scenes (tea left because his chill would cool it, boxes taken from a girl with a hurt hand, monthly checks); tenderness with animals that avoid him; small domestic tastes and household knowledge from a commoner mother (EXTRA09 obs. 105); literal-mindedness (V10 obs. 034, V11 obs. 084); and order under strain, which becomes a method in the V11 roll call. The monograph reports reading every Cyril-bearing register row, and EXTRA09 enlarges him most. A would overclaim: several details are paratext only, much of the evidence is comic set-pieces, and his private life at the Highorn house is sampled in few scenes. C would understate a driver that explains ordinary conduct across AFTER04, EXTRA09 and V10-V11.

The monograph argues Cyril Ashley's side of each relationship by recipient (section 8): the shout, supervision and recognition toward Monica Everett; devotion as service to Felix and respect kept with knowledge toward Isaac Walker; mockery endured from Claudia and pure hidden care for Neil; a truce with Elliott; the relaxed teacher with Glen; a slow change of address with Raul; the son with Myra and the nervous heir with the marquess; and the same courtesy to Brendan, Romaria, Byron and Melissa. It states the rule: his courtesy is constant whatever the other person feels, while register and confidence vary by rank and role. A is rejected: his interior view of Monica Everett is not recorded, Felix's and Isaac Walker's side is seen only from their viewpoint, and the Highorn family is sampled in few scenes.

Cyril Ashley has sustained viewpoint scenes, and the monograph uses them to set self-report against conduct (section 5). But it states that his interior is generous on duty, fear and self-reproach and spare on desire, that his feeling is unnamed by himself at V04 and his view of Monica Everett unstated at EXTRA09, and that his reasoning about her hand before V09 is not shown; the project ledger's readiness entries record INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE at every Cyril checkpoint. B would overclaim interior access the evidence itself calls uneven. D would understate interior evidence that supports the duty, fear and self-reproach mechanisms.

Located conflict conduct for Cyril Ashley: he investigates witnesses before blame (V01 obs. 091); defends Glen once Glen swears his innocence (AFTER04 obs. 074); rebukes Elliott's class sneer (AFTER04 obs. 093); accepts Byron's duel because it is asked in earnest (AFTER04 obs. 109, 154); keeps a promise to spirits against a Sage's advice (V07 obs. 025); drops his brooch to freeze Louis Miller, preferring to break with correctness (V09 obs. 066-067); and shields Isaac Walker in the V12 battle (V12 obs. 197). B would overclaim: there is no worked account of how he chooses among confrontation, procedure and self-sacrifice beyond the V09 reflection, the V06 duel is recorded only as lost, and conflict with Claudia and Elliott is comic or a truce. D would understate a located shift from procedure to judgment.

The monograph records located priorities for Cyril Ashley: fairness over rank, with investigation before blame (V01 obs. 057, 091); necessary work is not extra and 'cannot' is not accepted from himself; asking for help when one's strength fails is never wrong for others (V06 obs. 182); and from V09 he would rather break with correctness than be an ignorant, passive good person (V09 obs. 067). B would overclaim: these are stated positions and located acts rather than an analyzed deliberation, and he licenses in others what he forbids himself. D would understate priorities that recur from V01 to V09.

The monograph treats Cyril Ashley as a carrier of the series' gentle comedy, with tenderness undercut by his manner: calm insisted on while shouting, misreadings by Ray and Byron, literal-mindedness, Elliott braiding his hair and the rose dragon (section 9). B would overclaim: he is mostly the object of the comedy rather than its agent, and his own sense of humour is not analyzed. D would understate a comic register located and explained as character.

One dedicated monograph covers all sixteen units, with 718 observation references and every ledger ID checked mechanically at integration, a name-and-reference check and six stated defects, and it reports reading every Cyril-bearing synopsis paragraph and register row. B would overclaim: neither the analyst nor the integrator reread the Japanese source, owner semantic acceptance is not claimed, some points are cited to reading prose rather than observations, and two identifications (the V11 father and Wayne's name) are supported inferences. D would understate dedicated full-range coverage with located references.

Affirmative limits for Cyril Ashley are recorded: his constitution is still called a burden at V07 (V07 obs. 043); he keeps 'Highness' for Isaac Walker against invitation (V10 obs. 159); he confides his fear of night water to Isaac Walker but not to his juniors (V10 obs. 157); praise of his blood or his birth father's teaching wounds him (V04 obs. 014, V10 obs. 037); he still blames himself and feels useless as heir at V12 (V12 obs. 207); and he cannot read his own heart (V12 obs. 167). C would understate located countercases that bound the mechanisms.

Claims carry unit-prefixed observation numbers and ledger IDs; four orders are kept apart; the suspicion is told as a knowledge history in his order (section 3); and his family facts carry both diegetic place and point of revelation (section 4). A is rejected: elapsed story time is seldom given, ages are approximate, and some points are cited to reading sections.

conditions: Illustrative only, never quotation, and in a selected state: the shouting register by default toward juniors, the gentle register only in the bounded situations recorded, hyperbolic oaths for the prince before V08.

Address follows the recorded ledger for the selected state: Monica Everett by contemptuous pronoun, then 'Treasurer Norton', 'Lady' once, the magic count at the V09 reveal, 'Treasurer Norton' again and 'Monica' in their work after V09; 'Highness' for Felix and still for Isaac Walker; 'Lord Roseburg' and then Raul's name from V11.
No Japanese first-person form, sentence ending or catchphrase is invented, since the evidence quotes none.
No line names his feelings toward Monica Everett, states a verdict on her identity before V09, or is set after V12.
scenario_readiness.note: Stable register conditions and a located address ledger constrain illustrative speech for Cyril Ashley. The absence of quoted forms keeps the use narrow.

conditions: Predictions are limited to the established mechanisms: care given with a true but incomplete pretext; investigation before blame; recognition given promptly for work and received badly when addressed to his blood; self-blame beyond what he caused; confidence offered upward rather than to juniors.
The foundation of his loyalty is set by the selected state: an assigned object before V08, his own choice after; procedure before V09, judgment over correctness after.
His feelings toward Monica Everett and the marriage question stay unnamed and unresolved.
He does not learn what he never learns in the evidence: the erased memory, the treasurer's year, or the detail of Monica Everett's history.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected state from the monograph's table from V01 through V12 (for example V01 before or after the recognition by office; V04-AFTER04 as concealed protector and senior; V08 after the re-founding; V09 after the reveal; V10-V11 as heir and Library Society member). Prequel material is retrospection only, and no state after V12 is generated.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Recipients the monograph samples: Monica Everett as junior, Felix or Isaac Walker (under the V08 knowledge boundary), Glen, Claudia, Neil, Elliott, Raul, Myra, the marquess, or the minor recipients in section 8.9 in their sampled roles. Transfer to an unfamiliar junior or a stranger asking for help is a separate, lower-confidence condition resting on the general disposition Benjamin describes (EXTRA09 obs. 087).
setting_constraints: The academy student council, juniors and duels; the Highorn house and court; research management and the Library Society, of the kinds shown.
No romance or named feeling toward Monica Everett.
No magic, politics or family fact beyond what the monograph attests.

scenario_readiness.note: The established mechanisms support bounded extrapolation for Cyril Ashley in sampled settings at a selected state. His unread heart excludes that domain.

conditions: Sampled settings only: the council room and records room, juniors' errands, tea he leaves, animals that avoid him, the Highorn house with board games, and the market and research visits.
Hidden care with a pretext, literal-mindedness and order under strain as recorded; comic set-pieces are evidence of habit, not scripts.
No invented private life outside the sampled scenes.
scenario_readiness.note: A located driver for ordinary conduct supports narrow extrapolation for Cyril Ashley in the settings the monograph samples.

conditions: Only the located priorities: fairness over rank with investigation before blame; asking for help is never wrong for others; from V09, judgment over correctness when someone must be protected.
He forbids himself what he licenses in others; that asymmetry is kept.
No general moral philosophy is generated.
scenario_readiness.note: Located priorities support bounded deliberation for Cyril Ashley in situations like those sampled.

The evidence affirmatively leaves Cyril Ashley's feeling unnamed by himself (V04), his view of Monica Everett unstated, and his V12 heart unread after he asks Aurelia to decline (V12 obs. 166-167); the question is registered open (SW-P-0069), and Bridget's and Felix's views are their own. Generating romance would name what the text withholds.

conditions: Sampled functions only: vice-president and acting head of the council, instruction of the treasurer and juniors, monthly record checks, the duel and shortened-chant ice magic with deliberate use of over-absorption (V09 obs. 066, V11 obs. 049-050), heir duties at court, the Library Society and management of research funding.
His limits are part of the model: he does not know what his diligence stopped, and he feels unfit as heir at V12.
No spell, institution or political act beyond what the monograph attests is generated.
scenario_readiness.note: Council work, instruction and his magic are densely sampled for Cyril Ashley, supporting bounded extrapolation at a selected state.

known_limits.statement: The monograph was written by a fresh-context analyst from a snapshot of the ledgers and readings; neither the analyst nor the integrator reread the Japanese source, and owner semantic acceptance is not claimed.

The monograph reports that the project ledger records INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for any reconstruction tier at every Cyril Ashley checkpoint (SW-RD-0004, 0012, 0020, 0023, 0040), tied to his unstated view of Monica Everett and his reasoning about her hand before V09. The label is calibration evidence, not a conclusion adopted here.
Cyril Ashley's interior is generous on duty, fear and self-reproach and spare on desire; he has no viewpoint in V03.
The rival reading that his pretexts are his motives keeps real support: he never names care as his reason and his care extends to everyone. The monograph rejects only its strong form.
Cyril Ashley's and Monica Everett's V12 feelings are unnamed (SW-C-0093, SW-P-0069); Monica Everett believes in a betrothal while he has asked for the marriage talk to be declined.
The V11 father who forbade vulgar games is identified as the birth father by supported inference, and whether 'Wayne' is a given name or a surname is undecided.
He never learns that Thornley erased his memory or that his monthly checks stopped the embezzlement for a year (SW-K-0011, SW-K-0126).

All speech evidence is printed prose described in English; no Japanese is quoted and his first-person pronoun is not named, so no form, sentence ending or lexicon is available, and there is no voice evidence.

Romaria's silence and the brooch's glow, whether Romaria resents her rescue, the Highorn succession dispute in prequel evidence, and the identities the text withholds (the patron, the seventh Sage, Hilda Everett's collaborator, the prison's attacker) stay open and are not predicted.
No held-out validation, probe set or speech census is part of the curated evidence; generated dialogue is illustrative and its accuracy is untested.
